title: Step 2: Organizing data into training batches
diagram_summary: Three-stage pipeline for preparing and fine-tuning an LLM: Stage 1 (Preparing the dataset) covers downloading/formatting, batching, and creating data loaders; Stage 2 (Fine-tuning the LLM) covers loading a pretrained LLM, instruction fine-tuning, and inspecting modeling loss; Stage 3 (Evaluating the LLM) covers extracting responses, qualitative evaluation, and scoring responses.
